mechanism: Aggregates environmental signals (receptivity, system load, friction) to calculate a 'Readiness Potential'. Returns TRUE if the potential exceeds the sensitivity threshold.
invariants: Ephemerality: A True result at t=0 implies nothing about t+1.
Non-Compensatory: If the moment is wrong, more effort cannot fix it.

parameters.name: sensitivity
parameters.description: Readiness threshold (0 = always ready, 1 = never ready)

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Observation window for aggregating readiness signals
